findings.finding: Flash-attention parser rejected quoted logged command lines.
findings.repair: Use a word-boundary parser for --flash-attn on|off.

findings.finding: Firewall test rejected the explicit eval_v1_accessed=false audit field rather than real fixture access.
findings.repair: Reject the concrete eval_v1 path and require the false audit marker.

findings.finding: Qualified adapter accepted q4-path without verifying or recording the supplied Q4/Modelfile package pair.
findings.repair: Require both files, same owned package directory, and record both SHA256 values in session evidence.

findings.finding: Evidence manifest report exclusion was order-dependent.
findings.repair: Explicitly exclude final report and manifest to avoid circular/order-dependent hashing.

findings.finding: First regex hardening did not handle quoted flash-attention tokens in actual launch strings.
findings.repair: Normalize command-line quotes and parse flash-attention with explicit on/off token substrings.

findings.finding: The local wrapper used one-attempt wording even though OWRQ is reusable non-scientific infrastructure, and it did not bind its own blob/worktree ancestry.
findings.repair: Use reusable AUTHORIZED_OWRQ_LOCAL_QUALIFICATION semantics and bind clean worktree, implementation ancestry, wrapper blob, adapter blob, and qualifier blob.

findings.finding: Launch option regex used literal \\s in a raw regex, so known-bad and repaired launch lines were not recognized.
findings.repair: Use actual regex whitespace tokens and regression-test both space-separated and equals-form quoted launch lines.
